payload.description:
My Niche: Virtual Design Assistant


Being a recent graduate with my Bachelors in Interior Design finding my niche has been difficult because I am new to the professional world. I felt as if i didn't have lots of experience doing real projects even though i have formal training and all the tools to be successful. Participating in #levelup2021 has allowed me to realize where i want my career and business to go.


Listening to Aida has allowed me to pin point my niche. My niche is being a virtual design assistant. I understand both the Design and Design Assistant process and how to make it work. I also know how overwhelming it can be for solo designers who have a little too much work for themselves but not enough to fully hire an assistant.


I am a very creative person and love working with others to bring visions to life and solving design problems. The services i offer is creating mood boards, sourcing, floor plans, 3D renderings, modeling, tracking, and more. I am proficient in different programs from Foyr to CAD. My Niche is helping and collaborating with other designers who need extra help with their projects :).


I also have regular clients but being a virtual design assistant is my focus.

#richesinniches #levelupcontest #foyrcommunity #interiordesigner #community #niche


The designs below are renders of a salon that i was playing around with!

Hello sweet community! Since in my country people are still hesitating reaching up to interior designers regarding their homes, my niche and my purpose is to help them feel totally involved in designing their space. I am always doing my job with love and energy that comes from my clients, and I think that the residential projects for young families are my thing. I hope that everybody is surrounded by great people and always receive good vibes! #richesinniches #foyrcommunity #levelupcontest

data.text: My project management experience has helped me a TON! I run my design projects just like how I ran front-end product development projects using the Human-Centered/Design Thinking approach. Plus I understand how to create timelines, gantt charts, task boards, & budgets. There are a lot of similarities to building a product prototype and developing/implementing a room design.

Here to share my Niche with you :)


I love working with clients who are openminded and ready for something new. Staying on the forefront of materials, design, and technology enables me to help clients achieve the full potential of their space. One of the primary goals of my design is to connect my client with nature. Educating them about sustainable materials and explaining why they are better for their home and health is what I enjoy the most. To me, designing a space is like the process of rebirth/renewal. What gives me the most satisfaction throughout the journey it so see how a home blossoms and transforms my client’s environment to a healthy place where they can thrive. 


To me a space should look and feel good!

#richesinniches #foyrcommunity #levelupcontest

payload.description: MY NICHE : When I first moved to Canada, I felt homesick, living in my 1 BHK condo, felt like living in a hotel room with no room service. I thereafter decided my Design practice will be a service to help Indian Immigrants living in Canada feel at home away from their home with my transitional traditional style in their modern Canadian homes. This is my niche since the past 4 years and I have been living by it. !! MI CASA SU CASA #richesinniches #foyrcommunity #levelupcontest

data.text: I could feel your passion when reading this! This is very relatable as a designer. We are all creatives in different ways. We all have that one thing that sparks our creativity and passion.

﻿@Community﻿ A lot of people say, "Well I'm not an artist so I'm not creative" or "You're the expert I'm not creative". I ensure others that you don't have to be an artist or an expert in order to be creative. Creativity can even come in the form of organizing a closet or office space or even coming up with solutions to problems. That is creativity and I want clients to know that we all have it in us. I feel like it impacts the design process by actively making them feel included and that thy are major keys when it comes to design. It needs to be personal, not just one size fits all. Getting to know your client allows them to open up their creativity so that together you can help execute the best vision or design possible.
﻿@Rachel Acevedo﻿ Thank you!! Design is a mentality !!! I love that you were able to capture that

YES!! 👏 When your business is focused on how it can serve others and help them realize their own potential and skills THATS when I believe you really become indispensable! I love that you're not just serving up designs, you're serving up a mentality as well! Bravo!

LOVE your passion and commitment to your craft ﻿@Jazlyn﻿ ! We would love to hear about how you communicate this idea that all people are creative to your clients and how does this impact their input on the design process?

payload.description: I can't limit it to one so here is all. My niche is helping others understand that we are all creative. What I live for is bringing visions to life.
